svg.text: The write operation and the read operation on a byte-organised array
① address code 101 is placed on the address bus — word 5 is selected
② the data byte 10001101 is placed on the data bus
③ the Write command stores it at address 5, replacing what was there
① address code 011 is placed on the address bus — word 3 is selected
② the Read command is applied
③ the contents of address 3 appear on the data bus; address 3 is not erased
